scenarios.title: export source
plannedActions: Fresh synthetic Git repository containing exact copied current CLI/scripts/tests bytes, a tracked retired.txt deleted after commit, and explicitly included extra/included.txt.
node scripts/export-cli-source-manifest.mjs --output ${externalManifest} --include extra
expectedOutcomes: Exporter returns the exact output-byte digest and file count, records the tracked deletion and explicit untracked include, and preserves source names, types, modes and bytes.

scenarios.title: valid readback
plannedActions: The immediately preceding exported manifest remains outside source and its digest is unchanged. Only the already blocked character-aliases scenario is selected.
tracer app -- test --scenario character-aliases --source-manifest ${externalManifest} --source-manifest-sha256 ${digest} --output-dir ${externalOutput}
expectedOutcomes: Public test runner verifies exact manifest identity, file count, sorted-entry digest and producer-declared base commit; returns selected-scenarios-blocked, not-run and no app identity, preserving source and manifest.

scenarios.title: refuse overwrite
plannedActions: The exporter output already exists with known exact bytes.
node scripts/export-cli-source-manifest.mjs --output ${externalManifest} --include extra
expectedOutcomes: A repeated export exits 2 with fixed safe error and preserves existing manifest and all source names, modes and bytes.

scenarios.title: reject digest
plannedActions: Valid manifest bytes paired with a different syntactically valid all-zero SHA256.
tracer app -- test --scenario character-aliases --source-manifest ${externalManifest} --source-manifest-sha256 ${wrongDigest} --output-dir ${externalOutput}
expectedOutcomes: Runner reports source-manifest-digest-mismatch, null source identity and not-run; source and manifest remain unchanged.

scenarios.title: reject content
plannedActions: Only synthetic/story.txt content differs from the exported manifest; source file set is unchanged.
tracer app -- test --scenario character-aliases --source-manifest ${externalManifest} --source-manifest-sha256 ${digest} --output-dir ${externalOutput}
expectedOutcomes: Runner reports source-manifest-content-mismatch, null source identity and not-run; modified source and manifest remain unchanged.

scenarios.title: reject extra file
plannedActions: Original content restored, then extra/unlisted.txt added after export.
tracer app -- test --scenario character-aliases --source-manifest ${externalManifest} --source-manifest-sha256 ${digest} --output-dir ${externalOutput}
expectedOutcomes: Runner reports source-manifest-file-set-mismatch, null source identity and not-run; original plus extra file and manifest remain unchanged.

scenarios.title: reject missing file
plannedActions: Unlisted file removed; tracked synthetic/story.txt moved outside source.
tracer app -- test --scenario character-aliases --source-manifest ${externalManifest} --source-manifest-sha256 ${digest} --output-dir ${externalOutput}
expectedOutcomes: Runner reports source-manifest-missing-file, null source identity and not-run; missing-file fixture and manifest remain unchanged.

scenarios.title: reject ancestor symlink
plannedActions: Missing file restored, then synthetic directory moved outside source and replaced with symlink to that same directory, so referenced content still matches.
tracer app -- test --scenario character-aliases --source-manifest ${externalManifest} --source-manifest-sha256 ${digest} --output-dir ${externalOutput}
expectedOutcomes: Runner reports source-manifest-symlink, null source identity and not-run; source readlink target string and manifest remain unchanged; external target contents are not asserted.

scenarios.title: reject malformed json
plannedActions: Original source restored. New external manifest contains exactly a single opening brace and the CLI receives its correct digest.
tracer app -- test --scenario character-aliases --source-manifest ${malformedManifest} --source-manifest-sha256 ${matchingDigest} --output-dir ${externalOutput}
expectedOutcomes: Runner reports source-manifest-invalid, null source and not-run for malformed JSON with a matching outer digest, preserving source and variant manifest.

scenarios.title: reject schema
plannedActions: Original source and manifest cloned into a new external variant; only schemaVersion becomes 2; outer digest recomputed.
tracer app -- test --scenario character-aliases --source-manifest ${schemaManifest} --source-manifest-sha256 ${matchingDigest} --output-dir ${externalOutput}
expectedOutcomes: Runner reports source-manifest-invalid, null source and not-run for the unsupported schema version with matching outer digest, preserving source and variant manifest.

scenarios.title: reject unsafe path
plannedActions: Valid original manifest cloned externally; only first path becomes ../outside.txt; outer digest recomputed. The unsafe-path guard precedes sorting and entry reads.
tracer app -- test --scenario character-aliases --source-manifest ${unsafePathManifest} --source-manifest-sha256 ${matchingDigest} --output-dir ${externalOutput}
expectedOutcomes: Runner reports source-manifest-unsafe-path, null source and not-run for traversal path with matching outer digest, preserving source and variant manifest.

scenarios.title: reject duplicate path
plannedActions: Valid original manifest cloned externally; its first entry is duplicated adjacent to itself so paths remain sorted; outer digest recomputed.
tracer app -- test --scenario character-aliases --source-manifest ${duplicatePathManifest} --source-manifest-sha256 ${matchingDigest} --output-dir ${externalOutput}
expectedOutcomes: Runner reports source-manifest-invalid, null source and not-run for sorted duplicate paths with matching outer digest, preserving source and variant manifest.

scenarios.title: reject entry hash format
plannedActions: Valid original manifest cloned externally; only first entry sha256 becomes invalid-hash; outer digest recomputed.
tracer app -- test --scenario character-aliases --source-manifest ${invalidEntryHashManifest} --source-manifest-sha256 ${matchingDigest} --output-dir ${externalOutput}
expectedOutcomes: Runner reports source-manifest-invalid, null source and not-run for malformed entry hash with matching outer digest, preserving source and variant manifest.

scenarios.title: reject entry hash mismatch
plannedActions: Valid original manifest cloned externally; only first entry sha256 becomes 64 zeroes; source bytes unchanged and outer digest recomputed.
tracer app -- test --scenario character-aliases --source-manifest ${wrongEntryHashManifest} --source-manifest-sha256 ${matchingDigest} --output-dir ${externalOutput}
expectedOutcomes: Runner reports source-manifest-content-mismatch, null source and not-run for a well-formed wrong entry hash with matching outer digest, preserving source and variant manifest.

scenarios.title: refuse inside output
plannedActions: Original source restored; selected output inside-manifest.json is nonexistent inside source; original external manifest remains unchanged.
node scripts/export-cli-source-manifest.mjs --output ${sourceRoot}/inside-manifest.json --include extra
expectedOutcomes: Exporter exits 2 with fixed safe error; inside output remains absent, source snapshot is unchanged and original external manifest bytes are unchanged. Error text is intentionally generic; no claim that text alone distinguishes the internal guard.

scenarios.title: recover readback
plannedActions: Symlink removed and original synthetic directory restored; original exported bytes and digest reused.
tracer app -- test --scenario character-aliases --source-manifest ${externalManifest} --source-manifest-sha256 ${digest} --output-dir ${externalOutput}
expectedOutcomes: Restored source verifies with original file count, worktree hash, base commit and manifest digest, still returns blocked/not-run with no app identity; source and manifest remain unchanged.
